title: How to Join Sri Anjaneya Youth
content: Any youth or resident of Zarugumalli can register as a member of Sri Anjaneya Youth Association. To join, create a free account at the Sign Up page (/signup) on the website. After registering, you become a member of the association.

title: Executive Committee Membership
content: Registered members can apply for Executive Committee status through their profile page (/profile). The Executive Committee includes leadership roles such as President, Secretary, Treasurer, and other coordinator roles. Applications are reviewed by the association.

title: Member Directory
content: The complete list of active members, volunteers, and executive committee leaders is available on the Members page (/members) of the website. The member directory is kept up to date with current registered members.
